patterns.note: Prominent image-first content blocks, often featuring a large hero image followed by a gallery of smaller related images, creating a rich visual showcase for each project.
A two-column main content area on the homepage, with a primary feed of articles/projects on the left and a narrower sidebar for events and product highlights on the right.
Consistent use of a clear, modern sans-serif typeface for all text, maintaining high readability across headings, body text, and metadata.
A high-contrast palette dominated by white backgrounds and dark grey/black text, punctuated by a distinct, vibrant blue for interactive elements like links, buttons, and the brand logo.
A persistent header navigation that remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing continuous access to site navigation and search.
Project showcase sections consistently include a main image, title, brief description, and a detailed metadata block (architects, year, area, etc.), providing comprehensive information at a glance.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible and functional at the top of the screen as the user scrolls down, ensuring navigation is always accessible.

Content is structured using a responsive grid system, allowing for large, image-centric project displays that adapt to different screen sizes, often featuring a main image and a subsequent gallery of smaller images.
Interactive image carousels, likely powered by Swiper, are used within project showcases to display multiple related images in a compact, browsable format.

design_tokens.type_scale: A clear, hierarchical sans-serif scale with prominent, bold headings (~2-3x body) for project titles, and smaller, lighter text for metadata and descriptions.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons and some image containers, but predominantly sharp corners for overall layout elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks and sections, creating a clean, uncrowded feel, while metadata within project cards is more compact.

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly editorial, image-driven presentation of architectural projects, combining a clean, minimalist aesthetic with an impressive depth of detailed metadata for each entry. It effectively functions as a visual encyclopedia for architecture, prioritizing high-quality imagery and comprehensive information over flashy animations or complex layouts.
